# highlight.js upstream

These files are copied unchanged from the npm package `@highlightjs/cdn-assets` 11.12.0
(<https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js>), under the BSD 3-Clause license in `LICENSE`. The agent document
template references them, so documents need no network access to highlight code.

Each file's SHA-512 equals the Subresource Integrity hash that cdnjs publishes for 11.12.0:

| File | sha512 (base64) |
|---|---|
| `highlight.min.js` | `gzqHAlI1hVdzJ4wiQj/MkppDr6zgEdCoBsrXKRidcaZsSPvNQ3Fy5p7PpMt/8mltxTxMHj1Ur5NWbJdqIfpxgA==` |
| `languages/scheme.min.js` | `jBMQzvjgLw7IukQNf7dsljwwG0pZbGECZmr9YOkyugXJFZD0oSzup4gAjJXtRBX5zKpb0juAaLPHrmrCf5B3cA==` |
| `styles/github.min.css` | `0aPQyyeZrWj9sCA46UlmWgKOP0mUipLQ6OZXu8l4IcAmD2u31EPEy9VcIMvl7SoAaKe8bLXZhYoMaE/in+gcgA==` |
| `styles/github-dark.min.css` | `rO+olRTkcf304DQBxSWxln8JXCzTHlKnIdnMUwYvQa9/Jd4cQaNkItIUj6Z4nvW1dqK0SKXLbn9h4KwZTNtAyw==` |

To upgrade, replace the files from the new package version, check them against the cdnjs hashes, and update this
record and the version in `AGENTS.md`.
